{"summary":"Task v5-resolver-long-hard-1 (Python 3.11 resolver), stage 5 of 8; 26 actions remain. Future response contract: supply complete replacement contents for allowlisted engine.py and rules.py only; engine.solve(data) is the entrypoint. No third-party libraries, tools, network, or workspace access; stage passes are provisional.

Requirements revealed: packages maps names to version rows with deps; roots maps package names to inclusive [min,max] bounds. Return {"versions": ...} containing exactly the dependency closure of roots. Every selected version’s active dependencies must be installed; {name,min,max} imposes an inclusive range, and constraints from roots/dependencies on shared packages must all hold. Name-only dependencies require installation without narrowing its range. Backtracking may be required. Among feasible installations, maximize the version vector over sorted ALL package names, using -1 for absent names. If none is feasible, return {"error":"unsatisfiable"}. Newly revealed at stage 5: input blocked maps package names to forbidden versions; absent entries forbid nothing, so selected versions must not be blocked.

Current checkpoint artifact: engine.py delegates solve(data) to rules.resolve(data). rules.py handles root ranges, ranged and name-only dependencies, intersected constraints, backtracking, and lexicographic scoring; it does not yet filter blocked versions. It returns unsatisfiable if no assignment. Artifact contents are supplied in the source message. Earlier initial artifact was only a naive minimum-version chooser and is superseded.

Public receipts supplied: stage 3, 6 checks, public_pass; stage 4, 8 checks, public_pass. Stage 5 supplies two public blocked-version test cases but no stage-5 receipt. The nested prior memory reports stages 1–2 as 2 and 4 checks passed, respectively, but also contains stale/conflicting checkpoint statements; prefer the explicit stage 3/4 receipts above. Stages 6–8 requirements are unknown. Treat trial notes as unverified; do not invent a wrong attempt."}
